target: Capped elapsed solver consumption min(Total Runtime,7200 seconds)
purpose: Before-run resource planning/formulation comparison within one solver/version/hardware experiment
source: All48 published deterministic runs, three formulations on16 instances; failed and time-limit runs retained
forbidden: source CPU Runtime, which is WorkMeasure not seconds
calibration: None from target instance; all three formulations for instance held together
validation: 12 development instances; leave-one-instance-out;4 fixed metadata-hash confirmation instances
metric: mean over instances of mean absolute runtime error across all3 formulations; seconds
secondary: each formulation and each held instance
formulation-selection runtime regret; offline paired replay, not deployment effect
selection: minimum development whole-instance MAE; within1% prefer fewer fitted parameters
attempts: minimum5 material hypotheses; stop after2 substantive no-gain attempts once minimum met, using development only
confirm: separate no-fitting process after code/state/selection freeze; never reselect final winner
censoring: This endpoint is observed capped resource consumption, not unconstrained time-to-optimality. Runs reaching7200 retain target7200. Censoring is not imputed as a solved runtime.
limits: Single machine, Gurobi11, one deterministic seed per formulation/instance;16 structural instances not repeated runtime trials;4 confirmation units insufficient population claims.
